program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time, seed, state }) { const launchSpeed = inputs.launchSpeed; const g = 9.8; const t = time; const height = launchSpeed * t - 0.5 * g * t * t; const velocity = launchSpeed - g * t; const apexTime = launchSpeed / g; const apexHeight = (launchSpeed * launchSpeed) / (2 * g); const pixelsPerMeter = 60; const originY = 320; const ballY = originY - height * pixelsPerMeter; const ballX = 320; let motionState = "Moving up"; if (Math.abs(velocity) < 0.05) { motionState = "Still for an instant"; } else if (velocity < 0) { motionState = "Moving down"; } const gravityState = "Gravity pulls down"; const objects = []; objects.push(sdk.panel({ x: 40, y: 40, w: 560, h: 360, title: "Vertical Toss", state: motionState })); objects.push(sdk.axis("axis.y", { x: 120, y: 360, length: 260, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 3, label: "Height", unit: "m" })); objects.push(sdk.groundMark("ground", 320, 320, 100, "Launch")); objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.toss", ballX, ballY, 28, { role: "output" })); objects.push(sdk.arrow("vec.v", ballX + 25, ballY, ballX + 25, ballY - velocity * 15, { label: "v", role: "output" })); objects.push(sdk.arrow("vec.a", ballX - 35, ballY, ballX - 35, ballY + g * 15, { label: "a", role: "warning" })); objects.push(sdk.callout(ballX + 60, ballY - 20, [motionState, gravityState], { id: "callout.toss" })); return { frame: { width: 640, height: 420, objects: objects, readouts: [{ id: "motionState", value: motionState }, { id: "gravityState", value: gravityState }] }, quantities: { launchSpeed: launchSpeed, gravity: g, apexTime: apexTime, apexHeight: apexHeight, velocity: velocity, height: height } }; }

manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: Gravity slows the ball on the way up and speeds it up on the way down. At the top, the ball is still for an instant while gravity continues to pull downward.
manifest.description: A simulation of a ball tossed vertically upward on a height scale. A blue motion arrow shows velocity and a dashed warm arrow shows constant downward gravitational acceleration.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed, then press Play. At the top, playback pauses so you can inspect the arrows.
